# h3_network (Data Source)

Looks up a network (subnet) by `id`, or by `project_id` + `name` (or `cidr_block`). Use `subnet_name` for `h3_vm.subnet_name` and `id` for `h3_eip.network_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A subnet created in the console, looked up by name.
data "h3_network" "app" {
  name = "app"
}

resource "h3_vm" "worker" {
  name        = "worker"
  cpu         = 2
  memory      = "4Gi"
  image       = "ubuntu:24.04"
  ssh_key_ids = [var.ssh_key_id]
  subnet_name = data.h3_network.app.subnet_name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cidr_block` (String) CIDR block
- `id` (String) Network (subnet) ID
- `name` (String) Network name
- `project_id` (String) Project ID (UUID)

### Read-Only

- `gateway_id` (String) NAT gateway ID
- `gateway_ip` (String) Gateway IP address
- `gateway_name` (String) NAT gateway name
- `protocol` (String) IP protocol
- `status` (String) Network status
- `subnet_id` (String) Subnet ID (same as `id`)
- `subnet_name` (String) Subnet name in the platform (for `h3_vm.subnet_name`)
- `vpc_id` (String) VPC ID
- `vpc_name` (String) VPC name in the platform
